description:
Build bridges together, cross them, and aim for Treasure Island! Anything goes for bridge materials—wood, desks, or even pianos! Throw them and stick them together to build your path!
Throw, Stick, and Build! 
The road to Treasure Island is treacherous. It’s full of holes, and there is no path. Chop down trees or break crates to find wooden planks, furniture, and all sorts of items. Throw them and stick them together to create your bridge.
A Dangerous Journey
 Gargantuan snowballs and massive exploding flowers! Nature is baring its fangs, trying to return you to the earth. Handle these threats with caution and speed. Why speed...? See below!
The Approaching Storm 
There’s no time to dawdle. If the storm approaching from behind touches you, it’s instant death! To build bridges quickly, cooperation is essential.
An Ever-Changing World 
Stages change every day. You can breathe in fresh air daily.
Monthly RTA Mode 
Stages and rankings change every month. Compete with penguins from all over the world for the best time.
Co-op Play
 Build bridges with up to 8 players! Of course, you can go solo too. Let’s go get that treasure!
🎥【Regarding Videos and Streaming】
 Gameplay videos and streaming are welcome. Please check the following two points:
Please include the name of the game in the title. (Required)

Please include the URL of the Steam store page in the description. (Optional)
